data.narrative:
Union, a Seed-stage defense and security company that has raised $51.3M to date, was valued through triangulation against a Defense & Security peer universe comprising 10 private companies and 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS). Founders Will Somerindyke, Jon Reiland, and Joe Musselman lead the venture.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression methodology, using total capital raised ($51M) as a proxy for current value and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier for advancement from Seed to next stage, implies a valuation of $128M. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—UFORCE ($1.0B, Seed), Singularity ($400M, Series A), and NODA AI ($125M, Series A)—yields a median valuation of $400M, with a range of $125M to $1.0B. The dispersion reflects stage and maturity variation within the peer set.

Triangulation of both methods supports a valuation range of $109M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $264M. The wide range reflects two primary uncertainties: the significant valuation spread among defense-sector peers at similar stages, and whether Union's current stage positioning most closely aligns with the Seed-focused or Series A comparable set. Reconciliation would benefit from clarity on Union's revenue traction and customer concentration relative to named peers.
